name: read_style_guide
description: Read the style guide document for a run. Returns the style guide content plus a truncated flag and the total character count; content past the size cap is cut off with a truncation marker. By default reads the current run's style guide; pass runId to read another run's style guide. A run that has not written a style guide returns an unavailable result.

detailed: Reads a run's style guide document.
tool {participantRole} is reading the style guide

runId.description: Optional run id (run-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS) whose style guide to read. Omit it to read the current run's style guide.
